There is no way to see how much will be left over, so I assume a small amount of about 30 kcal. That leaves about 540 kcal eaten.

For macronutrients, I estimate about 28 g protein, 65 g carbohydrate and 18 g fat. Check: 28×4 + 65×4 + 18×9 = 112 + 260 + 162 = 534 kcal, which matches the energy estimate.
